_comments: THE FORECAST SNAPSHOT ACTION (#40). Its own file inside metadata/actions/ rather than appended to
`.sales-actions.json`, and that is the coordination answer rather than untidiness.
`filePattern` is `**/.*.json`, so MetadataSync picks up every dot-json in the directory. Another
session is building the MJ Queries this reads from and will likely add rows of its own here; two
sessions appending to one file is a guaranteed merge conflict, while two files in one directory is
none. Whoever adds the queries should add `.sales-forecast-queries.json` beside this on the same
SHAPE MATCHES `Sales.SyncActivities` exactly — Type Custom, CodeApprovalStatus Approved, Status
Active, params as an `MJ: Action Params` collection with `@parent:ID`. Sales now has two
hand-written actions and they are deliberately identical in shape.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DECIDE: where the numbers come from. That is the process-wide forecast source
factory, whose default is NULL — no source, nothing measured, and the Action reports NO_SOURCE. So
this is safe to ship Active before the queries exist. A forecast row is the case where an invented
number does the most damage: an activity nobody sent reads as obviously wrong, a plausible commit
figure does not, and it is indistinguishable from a real one the moment it lands.

fields.Name: Capture Forecast Snapshot
fields.Description: Capture a ForecastSnapshot row per (company, pipeline, owner) for a period, from the forecast queries. Skips a grain already captured today rather than adding a second capture minutes apart — the table is a series, and CapturedAt is what distinguishes real history from a double-run.
fields.UserPrompt: Capture the sales forecast snapshot for the current period.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: First day of the period to measure, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit BOTH this and PeriodEnd for the current calendar month in UTC. Supplying one alone is refused rather than half-filled: a snapshot filed against a period nobody chose is worse than no snapshot, because a forecast series cannot survive a mis-dated row.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Last day of the period to measure, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after PeriodStart — CK_ForecastSnapshot_PeriodOrder enforces it, and the job refuses first so the message names the caller rather than the constraint.
